messages.en: I'm thinking of getting my hair cut a bit shorter. Do you think it'd suit me?
Of course! You've had it short before, and it looked nice.
Have the residents here received the notice about the water supply disruption yet?
Yes, I just shared it in the WhatsApp group.

senses.en_definition: The act, process, or manner of flying.
A journey by aircraft; the movement of aircraft from place to place.
Aviation; the activities and matters relating to air transport.

messages.en: My flight's been delayed by two hours. Don't head out yet. I'll message you once I've landed, okay?
Okay, I'll wait for your message before heading out. Let me know when you've picked up your bags too.
I want to get some work experience before going back to studying.
Sounds good. Where have you applied for jobs so far?
